༄༅/ /lnga bsdus bza' lnga'i rtsis/dhru ba 'pho ba phyi nang gi rtsis/nyi khyim 'pho ba dhru ba sgra gcan 'pho ba dang bza' bsdus pa bcas bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /lnga bsdus bza' lnga'i rtsis/ dhru ba 'pho ba phyi nang gi rtsis/ nyi khyim 'pho ba dhru ba sgra gcan 'pho ba dang bza' bsdus pa bcas bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// 'das lor nyis 'gyur dpyid 'bring po// byin la 'og mar rgyu skar bsre// mig gis bsgyur la mda' ros bgo /thob pa steng gzhug zla dag go /gnas gsum bar ma so yis bsgyur// 'og ma ros thob bar ma sbyang*// lhag ma mkha' byin bar nas cig /'og phab sbyangs pas chu srang ngo*// dbus su me chu bsres byas la// drug cus bgos lhag chu tshod do// nor la bzhi bsnan steng la gzhug /thub pas steng bgos lhag ma gza'// zla dag dus bug zla ba bsre// gnas gnyis 'og mar dus nyis bgo /lhag ma cha shas thob pa la// dus mig bsres la steng bsgyur gzhug /klu lhag bgos lhag ril po'o// gnas gsum bar ma drag pos bsgyur// 'og mar ri dang bsre ba ste// dgu yon gyis thob bar ma sbyang*// lhag ma drug cu'i bsgyur thob pas// bar nas cig phab sbyangs pa'i lhag /chu srang yin te cig phab pa// dgu mes thob pa sbyangs pa dbugs// dbu mar thub pa yon tan sbyin// drug cus bgos lhag chu tshod do// nor la mda' dang mig bsres te// steng ma lag pas bsgyur la gzhug /de la skar bsgos lhag skar gnas// gza' la tshes byin dbyug gur phri// ril po byin te chu zla yis// bgos pa'i lhag mas rkang pa bzung*// 'byung mda' 'dod zung me mig zla// phyi ma zlog pa zla rkang ngo*// rkang bzung sngon mas cha shas bsgyur// ma zin dang pos bsgyur bar bya// dus nyis bgos thob chu tshod yin// lhag ma drug gi bsgyur thob pa// chu srang drug gis bsgyur thob dbugs// de ltar thob pa rnams kyis ni// sngar zin sdom zhing phyi zin dbri// sngar gyi chu zlas thob pa'i nor// mnyam na sbyin zhing mi mnyam dor// tshes grangs gnas gnyis steng chus bsgyur// 'og ma nyi shu gnyis kyis bsgyur// drug cus bgos thob steng la sbyin// gong mar thob ste skar gnas sbyin// lhag ma chu tshod chu srang gzhug

/gnas gnyis la ni skar ma nas// drug dang chu tshod gnas zhe lnga// med na 'khor bsre phyed lhag dor// dor ba'i lhag ma drug cus bsgyur// chu tshod bsres la mda' yon bzlas// thob pas nyi ma'i rkang ba bzung*// ro zung zla ba de bzlog pa'o// rkang zung sngon mas lhag ma bsgyur// mda' yon bzlas thob chu tshod yin// lhag ma drug cu'i bsgyur ba la// chu srang bsres la thob chu srang*// yang lhag drug bsgyur dbugs dang bsre// bgos thob dbugs yin de rnams kyi// snga rkang bsdam zhing phyi rkang phri// gza' dang nyi ma'i longs spyod dung*// lhor bsgrod dor zhing byang bsgrod sbyin// des ni gza' dang nyi skar dag /nyi skar cig la tshes grangs sbyin// 'og tu tshes la ro yis bsgyur// de la gza' yi longs spyod bsre// drug cus bgos thob nyi skar sbyang*// lhag ma chu tshod chu srang dbugs// sbyangs pa'i lhag ma zla skar yin// nyi zla bsres pas sbyor ba'o// tshes grangs lag bsgyur cig phri nas// ris bgos lhag ma byed pa'o// de ltar yan lag rnam pa lnga// snga mar gnyis 'phar zla dag tu// cig phri lhag ma'i gru ba bya// gza' gnas ris bgos lhag ma gza'// skar gnas nyi shu rtsa bdun la// chu tshod chung srang drug cu yin// dbugs la drug dang cha shas la// brgya dang nyi shu rtsa drug dang*// ril por nyi shu rtsa brgyad nas// lhag ma med phyir de dag gis// bgo ba'i nges par shes par bya// sgra gcan don du zla dag la// mkha' bug mkha' la bsre byas la// de la mig gis bsgyur bar bya// zla ba cig sbyin nyi mar gnyis// de la mkha' dus chus thob dor// lhag ma skar mas bsgyur thor skar// drug cus bsgyur thob chu tshod de// chung srang dbugs byas phyed dag go /de yis rgyu skar sbyangs pa gdong*// phyed bsres 'jug ste de nyid dang*// nya stong nyi zla'i skar gnas gnyis// gang mnyam de la 'jug pa yin// lnga bsdus nyi zla gzas 'dzin 'di// rang byung rdo rjes bsdus pa'o// rab skyes nas bzung lo dag la// bu ga dus dang ri phyed bsre// de la bzhi brgyas bsgyur bar bya// ri dang zla ba mda' yis dbri// de la ri zla me yis bgos// thob pa skar ma'i gnas yin no// lhag ma drug cus bsgyur la thob// chu tshod yin te bsgyur thob pa// chu srang drug gis bsgyur thob dbugs// skar gnas ris bgos lhag ma gza'// gza' la gnyis dang chu tshod du// mkha' me byin par byas pa yis// lo yi zla ba'i 'pho bar 'gyur// khyim gyi 'pho ba bzung ba'i phyir// lug sogs bcu gnyis rim pa ltar// gza' la cig dang chu tshod du// ri dang 'byung ba sbyin par bya// de ni lug gi 'pho 'tshams so// glang du rigs byed yon tan mda'// 'khrig pa zla ba ri dang zla// kar ka rigs byed me dang mda'// seng ge ri bong mig dang lag

/bu mor rigs byed zung mig sbyin// srang du drug dang mda' zla sbyin// sdig par zla ba ri zung ngo*// gzhur ni me dang drug dang zla// chu srin rigs byed mi dang me// bum par drug dang rigs byed do// nya la stong pa mig dang mda'// byin pas nyi ma'i khyim rnams su// 'pho ba'i nges pa bzung ba yin// mdor na nyi ma rgyu ba la// chu srang gsum dang dbugs bzhi yi// 'phel 'grib nyin mtshan ring thung byed// bsgrod pa mthar thug dus su ni// tshad shing grib ma la brtags la// gsal bar byi dor bya ba ni// nyi ma dag par 'gyur ba yin// gzhan du byed pas dag mi 'gyur// de phyir blo ldan shes par bya// shing mo yos lo dpyid 'bring bco lnga la dge'o/// / ༈ gza' lnga'i rtsis bzhugs so// na ma shri ka la tsakra/ zla ba dag pa sum cus bsgyur// da lta'i zhag byin gnas gsum bzhag /'og mar ri mkha' ris thob pa// dbus kyi phung por bsre bar bya// de la drug cu rtsa bzhis bgo /thob pa steng la dbri bar bya// de ni mi gsal nyin zhag rnams// gza' lnga spyi yi nyi ma ste// cig phri gsal ba'i nyin zhag go /bkra shis gsal bar bya ba'i phyir// dpyid nyir ring thung zla ba bsre// de la ri klu ro yis bgo /thob pa dor lhag skar mas bsgyur// ri sogs bgos thob skar ma'o// lhag ma mkha' ros bsgyur thob pa// dbyug gu'o de bzhin chu srang dbugs// rim bzhin byas pas longs spyod dang*// dal bar dag par bya ba'i phyir// gnas gnyis gcig la skar ma nas// dgu dang chu tshod sum cu sbyang*// ma 'dang 'khor lo bsres la sbyang*// sbyangs kyang 'khor lo phyed lhag dor// ma dor rim pa dor rim yin// dor lhag skar gnas drug cus bsgyur// 'og gi chu tshod steng du bsre// mda' yon bzlas thob dal rkang bzung*// de bzhin bco brgyad ri la rkang*// phyi ma la ni de las bzlog

/rkang zos sngon mas lhag ma bsgyur// mda' yon zlas thob chu tshod dang*// lhag ma drug cus bsgyur las thob// chu srang drug gis bsgyur thog dbugs// de ltar thob pa de rnams kyis// snga rkang sdom zhing phyi rkang dbri// sngar gyi longs spyod gnas rnams su// rim min sbyin zhing rim pas dor// dal ba'i longs spyod dag pa'o// dal dag gnas gnyis cig la ni// nyi ma dag pas sbyang bar bya// med na 'khor bsre phyed lhag dor// ma dor rim pa dor rim min// sbyang lhag skar gnas kyi rkang bzung*// rgyal ba dang po gsum me mig /lnga dang drug par nyi shu cig /bco brgyad tshes dang drag po ni// mi rnams rnga rkang rim pas so// drag po so brgyad brgya bcu dang*// lnga bcu rtsa gsum phyi rkang yin// rkang zos sngon mas chu tshod bsgyur// drug cus thob pa rkang pa'i nor// chu tshod yin te lhag drug cus// bsgyur thob chu srang drug gis ni// bsgyur ba thob pa dbugs yin no// rkang pa sngon mar zin na sdom// phyi mar zin na dbri bar bya// rkang gnas drug cus lhas gyur na// drug cus bgos pa skar ma yin// de ltar skar ma la sogs kyis// sngar gyi dal ba dag pa la// rim min dor zhing rim pas sbyin// mig dmar 'gyur ba dag pa'o// phur bu spen pa nyid kyang mtshungs// de nas gza' lag gsal brjod bya// spyi yi nyi ma brgya yis bsgyur// me dang nyi ma ri rnams dbri// ri phug ri klus bgos thob dor// lhag ma skar mas bsgyur thob skar// chu tshod chu srang dbugs rnams ni// rim bzhin byas pas longs spyod do*// dal ba dag par bya ba'i phyir// nyi ma phyed dag gnas gnyis bgod// cig la skar mar bcu drug dang*// chu tshod nas ni sum cu sbyang*// ma 'dang 'khor bsre phyed lhag dor// ma dor rim pa dor rim min// dor lhag rkang gnas drug bcus bsgyur// 'og gi chu tshod steng du gzhug

/mda' yon bzlas thob dal rkang bzung*// phyogs ri me yi phyir rkang bzlog /rkang zos sngon mas lhag ma bsgyur// chu tshod chu srang dbugs rims bzhin// snga rkang bsdom zhing phyi rkang dbri// sngar gyi nyi ma phyed dag la// rim min sbyin zhing rim pas dor// gza' lhag dal ba dag pa'o// dal rkang cig gis longs spyod sbyang*// med na 'khor lo phyed lhag dor// dor lhag rkang gnas kyis rkang bzung*// bcu drug lan gnyis tshes dang ni// bcu bzhi bcu gsum drag po ri// ma bsad nam mkha' snga mas te// rigs byed drag po mkha' mig dang*// nyer brgyad so bzhi phyi rkang ngo*// rkang zos sngon mas chu tshod bsgyur// drug cus bgos pa chu tshod de// chu srang dbugs kyang rim pas bya// sngar zin sdom zhing phyi zin dbri// sngar gyi dal ba dag pa la// rim min dor zhing rim pas sbyin// gza' lag myur ba dag pa'o// phur bu spyi yi nyi ma la// mkha' mkha' ro dang mig gis phri// so me rgya mtsho bgos thob dor// lhag ma skar mas bsgyur thob skor// skar ma'o chu tshod chu srang rnams// rims bzhin byas pas longs spyod do// gnas gnyis cig la skar ma nas// bcu gnyis sbyangs la de nyid kyis// ma 'dang 'khor bsre phyed lhag dor// ma dor rim pa dor rim min// dor lhag skar gnas drug cus bsgyur// mda' yon bzlas thob dal rkang bzung*// 'phrog byed dgu me phyir rkang bzlog /rkang zos sngon mas lhag ma bsgyur// chu tshod la sogs rim pas bya// snga rkang sdam zhing phyi rkang phri// sngar gyi longs spyod gnas cig la// rim min sbyin zhing rim pas dor// phur bu'i dal ba dag pa'o// dal dag gnas gnyis cig la ni// nyi ma dag pas sbyang bar bya// ma 'dang 'khor bsre phyed lhag dor// ma dor rim pa dor rim min// sbyangs lhag skar gnas kyis rkang bzung*// phyogs phyogs dgu brgyad drug ro dang*// lag pa zla ba'i phyi mar ni// me ro bug pa drag po dang*// bcu drug thub pa rim pas so// rkang zos sngon mas chu tshod bsgyur// drug cus thob nor chu tshod dang*// chu srang dbugs rnams rim bzhin bya// snga rkang sdom zhing phyi rkang phri// rim min dor zhing rim pas sbyin// bla ma'i myur ba dag pa'o// spa sangs spyi nyir phyogs kyis bsgyur// chu gter dang ni nor gyis phri// ri dang rgyal ba mig gis bgo

/thob pa dang po dor ba'i lhag /skar mas bsgyur thob skar gnas yin// chu tshod sogs byas longs spyod do// dal ba dag par bya ba'i phyir// nyi ma phyed dam gnas gnyis bgod// cig la skar mar drug sbyang bya// med na 'khor bsre phyed lhag dor// ma dor rim pas dor rim yin// dor lhag skar gnas drug cus bsgyur// 'og gi chu tshod steng du gzhug /mda' yon zla thob dal rkang bzung*// mda' bzung zla ba de bzlog phyir// rkang zos sngon mas lhag ma bsgyur// mda' yon zlas thob chu tshod do// chu srang dbugs rnams rim pas bya// snga rkang sdom zhing phyi rkang phri// sngar gyi nyi ma phyed dag la// rim min sbyin zhing rim pas dor// de ni dal ba dag pa'o// dal dag cig gis longs spyod sbyang*// med na 'khor bsre phyed lhag dor// dor lhag skar gnas kyis rkang bzung*// nyi shu rtsa lnga gnas gsum dang*// rgyal ba gnas gnyis nyer gnyis gnyis// bco brgyad tshes nor rtsa ba'o// dus dang mkha' me go dgu dang*// yon tan ri rnams phyi ma'o// rkang zos sngon mas chu tshod bsgyur// drug cus bgos thob chu tshod do// chu srang dbugs dag rim pas bya// snga rkang sdom zhing phyi rkang phri// sngar gyi dal ba dag pa la// rim min dor zhing rim pas sbyin// spa sangs myur ba dag pa'o// spen pa spyi yi nyi ma la// mkha' mig brgyad dang rigs byed dbri// drug ro ri mkha' zla bas bgo /thob pa dang po dor ba'i lhag /skar ma bsgyur thob skar gnas so// chu tshod sogs byas longs spyod yin// de nyid gnas gnyis gcig la ni// skar ma'am gnas nas bco brgyad dor// med na 'khor bsre phyed lhag dor// ma dor rim pa dor rim min// dor lhag skar gnas drug cus bsgyur// 'og gi chu tshod steng du gzhug /mda' yon bzlas thob dal rkang bzung*// nyer gnyis tshes dus phyi rkang bzlog

/rkang zos sngon mas lhag mas bsgyur// mda' yon zlas thob chu tshod do// chu srang dbugs dag rim pas bya// sngar zin sdom zhing phyi zin phri// sngar gyi longs spyod gnas de la// rim min sbyin zhing rim pas dor// dal ba dag pa de gnyis las// cig ni nyi ma dag pas sbyang*// ma 'dang 'khor bsre phyed lhag dor// dor lhag skar mas myung rkang bzung*// drug dang 'byung mda' rigs byed chu// mig dang zla ba mkha' lnga rkang*// mig chu 'byung ba ro dang nor// me rnams rim pas phyi rkang ngo*// rkang zos sngon mas chu tshod bsgyur// drug cus thob pa chu tshod yin// chu srang dbugs rnams rim pas byang*// snga rkang bsdom zhing phyi rkang phri// sngar gyi dal ba dag pa la// rim min dor zhing rim pas sbyin// spen pa'i myur ba dag pa'o// gza' rnams rgyu ba'i rim pa ni// myur ba'i las kyi dus su ni// ma rgal ma dor myur 'gros shar// rgal la ma dor dal 'gros lho// dor la ma rgal 'khyog 'gros nub// rgal dor 'byung 'gros byang du'o// gza' lnga rgyu ba gsal byed yin// da ni skyes khyim brjod par bya// mig dmar skyes khyim seng ge khyim// rta ba'i skar ma la skyes pa'o// zhing ni lug dang sdig pa ste// dgug dang drag po'i las la shis// gza' lag skyes khyim lha 'tshams la ni skyes pa'o// zhing ni 'khrig ma bu mos te// rgyas pa'i las la bsngags pa'o// phur bu'i skyes skar bu mo ste// me bzhi la ni skyes pa'o// zhing ni gzhu dang nya yin te// bskrad pa'i las ni 'grub byed pa'o// spa sangs 'khrig pa'i khyim skyes te// lag gi skar ma yin par nges// zhing ni khyu mchog srang yin no// dbang gi las la rab tu bsngags// spen pa'i khyim skyes gzhu yin te// snubs kyi skar mar shes par bya// zhing ni chu srin bum pa ste// bsad pa'i las la rab tu bsngags// de dag 'thab par byed pa ni// mig dmar dang ni gza' lhag gnyis// phur bu spa sangs de bzhin te// spen pa 'jug rings de gnyis ni// zhi khyim la brtsod zhes su grags// 'jug rings kar ka tar skyes te// chu smad kyis ni skar mar brjod// 'di ni nyi ma'i longs spyod dang*// lhan cig chu srang phyed dang gsum// lhag pas lo gsum gyur pa'i tshe// rim pa nyi ma'i mdun du'am// rim min rgyab tu 'byung bar byed// mthon nas dbyug gu gnyis gnyis te// zla cig skar ma'i gzugs su ste// zla phyed du ba dang bcas snang*// slar yang nyi mar lhan cig rgyu// lan cig 'char ba'i tshul shes pas// dus rnams kun du de shes 'gyur// gza' rnams 'bras rtsis gzhan du ltos// 'dir ni dus 'khor rgyud 'grel gyi// rtsa ba cung zad mi gsal ba// 'jug pa bde bar bya ba'i phyir// rang byung rdo rjes bsdus pa yin/// /

༈ dhu ba 'pho ba'i rtsis bzhugs// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo// grangs rnams kun gyi dang po la// rab skye sogs byin lo dag go /gnyis bsgyur dpyid 'bring la sogs bsre// gnas gnyis 'og mar gnyis kyis bsgyur// mda' ros thob pa dpyid zla dag /gnas gsum bar mar so yis bsgyur// 'og mar drug gis rnyed pa la// gnyis phri bar sbyangs lhag ma mkha'// byin nas bar nas cig phab sbyangs// chu srang yin no bar ma ni// drug cus bgos lhag chu tshod de// thob la gnyis phri steng la gzhug /bdun gyis bgos pa'i lhag ma gza'// zla dag brgyad phri gnas gnyis bya// 'og mar dus dang nyi ma yis// bgos lhag cha shas thob pa las// cig bsres steng du lag bsgyur gzhug /klu lag bgos lhag ril po yin// gnas gsum bar mar drag pos bsgyur// 'og tu gsum phri dgu mes bgo /thob pas ma sbyangs lhag drug cus// bsgyur thob yang lhag drug bsgyur thob// gcig phab rims sbyangs chu srang dbugs// dbus mar nyi shu rtsa lnga bsres// drug cus bgos lhag chu tshod de// thob pa steng mig bsgyur la gzhug /de la skar bgos lhag skar gnas// gza' la tshes sbyin dbyug gur phri// ril por tshes byin bcu bzhis bgo /lhag mas zla ba'i rkang ba bzung*// 'byung mda' 'dod zung me mig zla// phyi ma la ni de nyid zlog /stong bas stong pa rnam dag cing*// bcu gsum zla ba'i rkang par lnga// gnyis dang bcu gnyis phyogs yin la// bcu cig mer ni bco lnga'o// bcu dang bzhir ni bcu dgu ste// dgu dang lnga par nyi shu gnyis// brgyad dang drug par nyi shu bzhi// bdun par nyi shu rtsa lnga yin// rkang zin sngon mas cha shas bsgyur// dus gnyis bgos thob chu tshod zin// lhag ma drug cus bsgyur thob pa// chu srang drug gis bsgyur thob dbugs// sngar zin sdom zhing phyi zin phri// thob mnyam sbyin dang mi mnyam dor// tshes grangs gnas gnyis steng chus bsgyur// 'og mar nyi shu gnyis kyis bsgyur// drug cus bgos thob steng du sbyin// de bgos thob pa skar gnas sbyin// lhag ma chu tshod chu srang gzhug

/nyi ma phyed ni dag pa'o// gnas gnyis cig la skar ma nas// drug dang chu tshod zhe lnga sbyar// med na 'khor bsre phyed lhag dor// lhag ma drug cus bsgyur ba la// chu tshod bsres la mda' yon bzlas// bgos pas thob pas rkang ba bzung*// drug bzhi zla ba phyi mar bzlog /gcig dang lnga la drug yin te// gnyis dang chu bo dag la phyogs// gsum pa drag po stong bar dag /rkang bzung sngon mas lhag ma bsgyur// mda' yon bzlas thob chu tshod de// mkha' ros bsgyur la chu srang gzhug /thob pas chu srang lhag drug gis// bsgyur thob dbugs su shes par bya// sngar zin sdom zhing phyir zin phri// gza' dang nyi ma'i longs spyod du// lhor bsgrod dor zhing byang bsgrod sbyin// nyi skar gcig la tshes grangs byin// 'og tu tshes la lo yis bsgyur// de la gza' yi longs spyod bsre// drug cus bgos thob skar gnas sbyang*// lhag mas chu tshod la sogs sbyang*// sbyangs pa'i lhag ma zlos skar yin// nyi zla gnyis bsres sbyor ba yin// tshes la mig gis bsgyur ba la// gcig phri ris bgos byed pa'o// zla dag chu bo drag po bsre// mig gis bsgyur la zla ba gcig /nyi mar gnyis sbyin mkha' dus chu// bgos thob dor zhing ma thob lhag /skar bsgyur bgos thob skar gnas te// chu tshod chu srang dbugs rnams bya// sgra gcan phyed dag nyid yin no// de yis rgyu skar la sbyangs gdong*// rgyu skar phyed bsres 'jug ma'o// zla dag mig dang lag pa bsres// sum cus bsgyur la chu bo phri// gnas gsum 'og mar ri mkha' ris// thob pa dbus bsre re bzhis bgos// thob la gcig phri gter la phrog /ris bgos tshes gzar mtshungs na dag /ma mtshungs gcig gis snon 'brid bya// bkra shis spyi nyer mkha' klu zla// phri la ri klu drug gis bgos// thob pa dor la longs spyod bya'o// gza' lhag spyi nyir brgya yis bsgyur// ri me ri ro bu kha phri// ri phug ri klus bgos thob dor// phur bu spyi yi nyi ma la// bu ga zla ba rigs phyed bsres// so me rgya mtshos sa thob dor// pa sangs spyi nyir phyogs kyis bsgyur// drug dgu mkha' dang klu yis phri// ri dang rgyal ba mig bgos dor/

spen pa spyi yi nyi ma la// me mda' chu bo zla ba bsres// drug ro ri mkha' zlas thob dor// lhag ma thams cad skar mas bsgyur// rang rang dkyil 'khor gyis bgos thob// skar ma'i lhag ma drug cus bsgyur// thob pa chu tshod lhag drug cus// bsgyur thob chu srang drug gis ni// bsgyur thob dbugs te longs spyod yin// de nas dal ba bya ba'i phyir// mig dmar phur bu spen pa gsum// longs spyod gnas gnyis gcig la sbyang*// lag sangs nyi ma phyed dag la// rang rang skyes khyim bzung ba'i phyir// mig dmar skar ma dgu dang ni// chu tshod sum cu sbyang bar bya// gza' lhag skar ma bcu drug dang*// chu tshod nas ni sum cu sbyang*// phur bu skar ma bcu gnyis sbyang*// pa sangs skar ma drug sbyang bya// spen pa skar ma bco brgyad dor// ma ldang 'khor bsre phyed lhag dor// ma dor rim pa dor rim min// dor lhag skar gnas drug cus bsgyur// chu tshod bsres la mda' yon zlas// bgos thob la rkang bzung bar bya// bkra shis de nyid bco brgyad ri// snga ma'i phyi rkang de bzlog pa'o// gza' lhag phyogs re me zlog chi// phur bu drag po dgu me bzlog /pa sangs mda' zung zla zlog phyi// spen pa nyer gnyis tshes ro zlog /rkang bzung sngon mas lhag ma bsgyur// ma zin dang pos bsgyur bar bya// mda' yon bzlas thob chu tshod de// lhag ma drug cus bsgyur thob pa// chu srang drug gis bsgyur thob dbugs// snga rkang bsdoms zhing phyis zin dbri// mig dmar phur spen longs spyod la// lag sangs nyi ma phyed dag la// rim pas dor zhing rim min sbyin// de ni dal ba dag pa'o// myur ba'i nges pa bzung ba zhi*// bkra shis phur bu spen pa gsum// nyi ma dag pa sbyang bar bya// lag dang pa sangs longs spyod sbyong*// med na 'khor bsre phyed lhag dor// ma dor rim pa dor rim min// sbyangs lhag skar gnas kyi rkang bzung*// rgyal ba dang po gsum me mig

/lnga dang drug par nyi shu gcig /bco brgyad tshes dang drag po me// snga rkang drag po so brgyad dang*// brgyad cu nga gsum phyi bkra shis// bcu drug lan gnyis tshes dang ni// bcu bzhi bcu gsum drag po ri// mda' dang nam mkha' snga ma ste// rigs byed drag po nyi shu dang*// nyer brgyad so bzhi phyi gza' lag /phyogs phyogs dgu brgyad drug ro dang*// lag zla phyi rkang me ro bug /drag po bcu drug ri bla ma// nyer lnga gnas sum nyer bzhi gnyis// nyer gnyis lan gnyis bco brgyad dang*// tshes nor snga ma'o drug sum cu// go dgu don gsum spa ba sangs// drug dang 'byung mda' rigs byed chu// mig dang lag pa mkha' snga rkang*// mig chu 'byung ba ro dang nor// me rnams spen pa myur rkang yin// rkang zos sngon mas chu tshod bsgyur// mkha' ros thob pa chu tshod de// lhag bsgyur chu srang bcu thob pa// chu srang drug gis bsgyur thob dbugs// snga rkang bsdom zhing phyi zin phri// so so da la ba dag pa la// rim min dor zhing rim pas sbyin// gza' lnga'i myur ba dag pa'o// gza' rnams rgyu ba'i rim pa ni// ma skal ma dor myur 'gros shar// rgal la ma dor dal 'gros lho// dor la ma rgal 'khyog 'gros nub// rgal dor 'byung 'gros byang du'o// myur ba gal te ma nges na// sbyin dor bzlog pas gsal bar 'gyur// lnga bsdus sgra gcan gza' lngar bcas// nyung bsdus shin du gsal bar bkod// gzhan yang dhu ba 'pho ba ni// gza' la cig dang chu tshod du// so gnyis byin la chu srang nas// bcu phri ril char gnyis dang gcig /skar mar gnyis dang chu tshod du// drag po byin la chu srang nas// gcig phri dbugs gsum dor ba na// zla ba phyi ma'i dhu bar 'gyur// gza' la dgu dang chu tshod drag /ril por bcu gnyis cha shas drug /skar mar bcu gsum chu tshod lnga// chu srang nga cig zla drug 'pho// sgra gcan dbugs gnyis chu srang du// sum cu gcig dang chu tshod gsum// zla phyed 'phos te phyed dag gzhug

/dbugs gsum chu srang bco lnga dang*// chu tshod zhi gnyis zla drug 'pho// rgyu skar la ni sngar bzhin sbyang*// nyi ma'i rkang pa ma zin nas// zhag lnga re la chu tshod re// zla cig ma yin gnyis pa la// zhag phyed brgyad la chu tshod re// de nas zla phyed chu tshod cig /de nas zla cig 'phel 'grib med// yang ni sngar bzhin 'bri bas na// nyi mar dus dang ro dang klu// bcu dang 'phrog byed 'phrog byed dang*// drag po phyogs dang klu dang drug /me dang nam mkha' zhes bya ba// zla phyed bcu gnyis rim pa ltar// lhor bsgrod dor zhing byang bsgrod sbyin// nyi rkang le lo can yin no// khyim gyi 'pho ba'i nges pa ni// 'di dag skar ma drug cus bsgyur// 'og gi chu tshod steng du gzhug /mda' yon bzlas thob 'das pa'i khyim// lhag ma sum cur bsgyur ba la// chu srang gsum gyi bgos thob gzhug /mda' yon zlas thob khyim de'i zhag /lhag ma drug cus bsgyur thob pa// chu tshod de bzhin chu srang dbugs// nyi ma 'pho ba'i nges pa'o// brtsi sla ba'i phyir rang byung rdo rjes sbyar ba'o// 'gro ba la phan par gyur cig / ༈ phyi nang gi rtsis bzhugs/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// phyi nang rtsis kyis rten 'brel cig /'dir ni brjod na 'gal ba med// skyes bu zhag gcig dus ni gang*// thabs dang shes rab dbye ba la// 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor lnga lnga bcu// zla nyi sgra gcan gsum gsum gyis// yud tsam sum cu yin par brjod// dkyil 'khor re rer thabs shes rlung*// bcu ste zhag cig dbyug tshod brgya// dbyug gu cig la rigs ldan drug /rigs ldan re la dbugs drug ste// chu srang zhes kyang brjod par bya// nang du ji ltar 'khor ba bzhin// phyi rol lo gcig dus sbyor la// sum brgya drug cu'i zhag yod kyang*// so drug zhag gi tshan pa bcu// zhag re yud tsam sum cu ste// gsum gsum bcu char shes par bya// nyis stong brgya dang drug cu yi// dbugs dbyung de yi sum cha yi// yud tsam bdun brgya nyi shu'o// dbugs tshod brgya yi re re la// dbugs ni nyi brgya bcu drug go

/dbyugs tshod re la rigs ldan drug /re re dbugs ni sum cu drug /de la chu srang drug yod de// de ni dbugs drug rang bzhin yin// phyi yi lo cig chu tshod dang*// nang gi dbugs drangs mthun pa yin// de la ye shes rlung bshad pa// drug brgya bdun cu rtsa lnga po// dkyil 'khor bcu yi re re la// drug cu rtsa bdun phyed dang bcas// yud tsam nyer gnyis phyed bcas yin// dbyug tshod drug dang bzhi gsum yod// rigs ldan dbugs gcig dang brgyad cha'o// bsdus na dbugs kyi so gnyis cha// 'dir ni zhag lhag shes par bya// zhag drug bzhi gsum cha dang dman// rang byung rdo rjes bris pa'o/// / ༈ nyi khyim 'pho ba dhu ba sgra gcan 'pho ba dang gza' lnga bsdus pa'o// khyim gyi 'pho ba'i nges pa ni// nyi dag skar ma drug bcus bsgyur// 'og gi chu tshod steng du zhugs// mda' yon zlas thob bzlas pas khyim// lhag ma sum cus bsgyur ba la// chu srang sum gyis bsgos thob zhugs// mda' yon zlas thob khyim de'i zhag /lhag ma drug cus bsgyur thob pa// chu tshod de bzhin chu srang dbugs// nyi ma 'pho ba'i nges pa yin// nyi ma'i longs spyod bshad par bya// dbugs zla chu srang nyi shu drug /chu tshod rigs byed rtag pa yi// nyi ma nyin re'i longs spyod yin// chu srang gsum dang dbugs bzhi yi// nyin mtshan ring thung byed pa yin// gzhan yang dhu ba 'pho ba ni// gza' la gcig byin chu tshod du// so sbyin chu srang bcu dor la// ril po gnyis dang 'og tu cig /skar mar gnyis dang chu tshod du// drag po sbyin zhing chu srang nas// cig phri dbugs gsum dor ba ni// zla ba phyi ma'i dhū bar 'gyur// sgra gcan dbugs gnyis chu srang du// sum cu gcig dang chu tshod gsum// zla phyed 'pho ste cho ga gzhug /rdong gzhug sngon bzhin shes par bya/// // /zla ba dag pa sum bcus bsgyur// gnas gsum 'og mar mig so phri// do la ro mkha' rib thob la// bla ma sros la dbugs mar sbyin// drug cu rtsa bzhis thob pa yis// steng phri spyi yi nyi ma yin// de la re bgos tshes gza' mtshungs// bgo mi mtshungs la snon 'brid bya// bkra shis gsal bar bya ba'i phyir// spyi nyir ri dus zla ba bsre// ri klu ro yis bgos thob dor// gza' lag spyi nyi brgya yis bsgyur// me dang lag pa byung ba phri// ri phug ri klus bgos thob dor// phur bu spyi yi nyi ma la// bu ga byung ba mig gis bsre// so me rgya mtshos bgos thob dor// pa sangs spyi nyi phyogs kyis bsgyur// mda' yon me dang zla ba phri// ri dang rgyal ba mig bgos dor// spen pa spyi yi nyi ma la// rgyu skar ri dang thub pas bsre// drug mo ri mkha' zla thob dor// lhag ma thams cad skar mas bsgyur// rang dang dkyil 'khor gyis bgos thob// skar ma'o lhag ma drug cus bsgyur// thob pa chu tshod lhag drug cus// bsgyur thob chu srang drug gis ni// bsgyur thob dbugs te longs spyod yin// de nas dal ba bya ba'i phyir// mig dmar phur bu spen pa gsum// longs spyod gnas gnyis cig la sbyangs// lag yang nyi ma phyed dag la// rang rang skyes khyim bzung ba'i phyir// mig dmar skar ma dgu dang ni// chu tshod sum cu sbyang bar bya// gza' lhag skar ma bcu drug dang*// chu tshod nas ni sum cu sbyang*// phur bu skar ma bcu gnyis sbyang*// pa sangs skar ma drug sbyangs la// spen pa skar ma bco brgyad dor// ma ldang 'khor lo bsres la sbyang*// sbyangs kyang 'khor lo phyed lhag dor// ma dor rim pa dor rim min// dor gnas skar gnas drug cus bsgyur// chu tshod bsrel la mda' yon bzlas// bgos thob dal rkang bzung bya ba// bkra shis de nyid bco brgyad ri// snga ma'o phyi skas de las bzlog

/gza' lag phyogs ris mo snga rkang*// phyi ma bzlog par shes par bya// phur bu drag po dgu dang me// phyi rkang de nyid bzlog pa yin// pa sangs mda' bzung zla bzlog phyir// spen pa nyer gnyis tshes ro zlog /rkang bzung sngon mas lhag ma bsgyur// ma zin dang pos bsgyur bar bya// zla yon zla thob chu tshod de// lhag ma drug cus bsgyur thob pa// chu tshod yang bsgyur thob chu srang*// drug gis bsgyur thob dbugs yin no// snga rkang bsdom zhing phyi zin dbri// mig dmar phur spen snga ma yi// longs spyod cig la byin dor bya// lag pa pa sangs nyi phyed la// ri min sbyin zhing rim pas dor// des ni dal ba dag pa'o// myur ba'i nges pa bzung ba ni// bkra shis phur bu spen pa gsum// nyi ma dag pa sbyang bar bya// lag dang pa sangs longs spyod sbyang*// med nas 'khor bsre phyed lhag dor// ma dor rim pa dor rim min// sbyang lhag dkar gnas kyis rkang bzung*// rgyal ba dang po gsum mo mig /lnga dang drug par nyi shu gcig /bco brgyad tshes dang drag po me// snga rkang drag po so brgyad dang*// brgya bcu nga gsum phyi bkra shis// bcu drug lan gnyis tshes dang ni// bcu bzhi bcu gsum drag po ri// sa dang nam mkha' snga mas te// rig byed drag po nyi shu dang*// nyer brgyad so bzhi gza' lhag go /phyogs phyogs dgu brgyad drug ro dang*// lag zla phyi rkang mi ri phug /drag po bcu drug ri bla ma// nyer lnga gnas gsum nyer bzhi gnyis// nyer gnyis lan gnyis bco brgyad dang*// tshes nor snga rkang drug gsum bcu// go dgu don gsum pa sangs yin// drug dang 'byung mda' rigs byed chu// mig dang lag pa mkha' snga rkang*// mig chu 'byung bar ro dang nor// mo rnams spen pa'i myur rkang yin// rkang zos sngon mas chu tshod bsgyur// mkha' ros thob pa chu tshod de// lhag bsgyur bco lnga bcu thob pa// chu srang drug gis bsgyur thob dbugs// snga rkang bsdam zhing phyi zin dbri// so so dal ba dag pa la// rim min dor zhing rim pas sbyin// gza' lnga'i bsgyur ba dag pa'o// gza' rnams rgyu ba'i rim pa ni// ma rgal ma dor myur 'gro shar// rgal la ma dor dal 'gros lho// dal la rgal 'khyog 'gro ba nub// rgal dor 'byung 'gros byang du'o// zhing dang stobs dang brtsod pa dang*// 'bras bu gzhan du shes par bya// zhi ba gal te ma nges na// myur ba'i sbyin dor bzlog pas shes// gza' lnga nyung bsdus gsal byed 'di// rang byung rdo rjes bris pa yin// dge bas thams cad mkhyen thob shog

/me mkha' dang mthun par dag par byas so// gyi ba can gyi de dang cig /gza' lnga la nyi zla'i 'gros kyi lugs kyis rim pa dang rim min bdun ga /sbyin pa bzhi cha cig /rim pa rim gnyis ka dor ba bzhi cha gcig /de gnyis bzlog nas yong ba bzhi cha cig /myur ba'i sbyin nor go bzlog dgos pa bzhi cha gcig /yod dgos par 'dug /'di ma byas na lugs 'byung du rtsis kyang*/ bzhi cha cig dmigs skar dang mi 'grig par 'dug lugs bzhi po de nas mi 'chug par snang ngo*// dal myur rkang ba mgyogs brgyad du// skar khongs gnyis gnyis tshun chad du// gal te gza' de ma rnyed na// de tshe ltas ston 'gros zhes bya// tshul de seng ge rgyal mtshan 'dod// zhes bya ba 'di yang*/ gnad 'di ma shes pas lan 'dug go /kha cig rkang pa bzlog na yong zer te/ de yang mi bden te brdzun no/// / ༈ rgyu skar dus kyi pho nya rtsogs 'dus bzhugs/ na ma shri ka la tsakra ye/ dus kyi pho nya rtsogs 'dus lo// khyim bsgyur dpyid zla 'bring sogs bsre// gnas gnyis 'og mar gnyis kyis bsgyur// de la gsum sbyin mda' ros bgo /rnyed pa steng sbyin zla dag go /gnas gsum bzhag pa'i bar ma la// so yis bsgyur la nyer dgu sbyin// 'go la dgu phri drug gis bgod// ros thob bar sbyang lhag mkha' byin// bar nas cig phab sbyang chu srang*// bar ma drug cus bgo lha dbyug /snyed pa steng bcug bdun gyis bgo /lhag ma tshes gza'i nges pa yin// zla ba dag par bcu dgu bsre// gnas gnyis 'og mar dus gnyis bgo /lhag ma cha shas thob pa de// steng ma gnyis kyis bsgyur ba gzhug /klu lhag bgos lhag ril po'o// zla ba dag par nyer lnga bsre// gnas gsum bar mar drag pos bsgyur// 'og tu dgu mes thob pa la// bcu drug bsres la bar ma sbyang*// lhag ma drug cu dang drug gis// bsgyur thob steng nas cig phab sbyang*// chu srang dbugs yin bar ma de// drug cus bgos lhag chu tshod de// steng ma gnyis bsgyur thob nor sbyin// de la skar bgos lhag skar gnas// gzhan dag spyi dang 'dra ba yin// // zla dag tshes bsre gnyis kyis bsgyur// zla bar cig byin nyi mar gnyis// thub lag gis bsgyur mkha' dus chu// bgos thob skar gnas lhag drug cus// bsgyur sogs byas pa phye dag yin// de yis rgyu skar la sbyangs gtong*// rgyu skar phyed bsres 'jug ma'o//

༈ dpal dus kyis 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo// rab tu skye ba nas bzung nas// thig ler 'das pa byin pa lo// zla ba'i don du nyi mas bsgyur// dpyid zla 'bring sogs 'das pa sbyin// gnas gnyis 'og mar thub pa bsre// mig gis bsgyur la mda' rol bgo /thob pa steng gzhug zla dag go /gnas gsum bar ma so yis bsgyur// 'og mar phyogs phri ros dag pas// dbu ma'i phung po sbyar bar bya// lhag ma mkha' byin steng nas byin// 'og tu phab pas drug cur 'gyur// mal byin gnyis phri lhag chu srang*// dbus mar mig dang rgya mtsho sbyin// drug cu thob pa stengs su sbyin// lhag ma gza' yi chu tshod yin// thub pas steng bgos lhag ma gza'// zla dag gnas nyid 'og ma la// klu zla byin la dus nyid kyis// bgos pa'i lhag ma cha shas yin// thob pa'i cha la gsum bsres te// steng ma lag pas bsgyur la gzhug /klu lhag bgos lhag rim pa'o// zla dag gnas gsum bzhag dbus ma// drag po bsgyur te mtshon mda' bsre// 'og tu klu bsre gong me yis// thob pa'i nor gyis bar ma sbyang*// 'og gi lhag ma drug cus bsgyur// dgu mes thob pa'i nor gyis ni// bar nas cig phab sbyangs pa'i lhag /chu srang yin te gcig phab pa// dbu mes thob pas sbyangs pa dgugs// dbus ma drug bcus thob pa yi// lhag ma skar ma'i chu tshod yin// thob pa'i nor la gcig phri nas// steng ma mig gis bsgyur la gzhug /de la skar bsgos lhag skar gnas// gza' la cig ni rab sbyin cing*// chu tshod du ni so gnyis sbyin// chu srang nas ni phyogs dor bya// ril por gnyis sbyin 'og tu gcig /skar mar gnyis dang skar ma yi// chu tshod du ni bcu gcig sbyin// chu srang nas ni gcig dor zhing*// de bzhin dbugs nas gsum phri bas// zla ba phyi ma'i brtsis bzhir 'gyur// gza' la tshes sbyin dbyug gur phri// ril ril por byin chu zla yis// bgos las lhag mas rkang pa bzung*// bgor med nas ni de nyid bzung*// thob mnyam sbyin dang mi mnyam dor// 'byung dang 'byung pa mda' rig byed// me dang lag pa ri bong can// phyi ma la ni de las bzlog

/zla ba'i rkang par shes par bya// stong bas stong pa rnam dag cing*// bcu gsum zla bas rkang ba lnga// mig dang nyi mar phyogs yin la// bcu gcig mer ni tshes zhes bya// bcu dang chu bo rkang par ni// nyi shur cig gis ma longs pa// lnga dang phug par nyi shu gnyis// dus dang klur ni nyi shu bzhi// bdun par nyi shu rtsa lnga yin// rkang chung sngon nas cha shas bsgyur// ma zin dang po bsgyur bar bya// dus gnyis bgos thob chu tshod yin// lhag ma drug cus bsgyur ba la// bgos pas thob pas chu srang ngo*/ drug gis bsgyur la bgos thob dbugs// de ltar thob pa de rnams kyis// sngar gyi rkang pa'i
